rows.n: Customs data record 34.5 Mt of wheat exports from Russia in 2024 (CEPII BACI); USDA PSD gives 55.5 Mt for 2023/24 and 43 Mt for 2024/25. These flows may rest on importers' declarations alone, so that destinations which do not report are missing; this is not established here.

notes: Flows are BACI calendar-2024 customs flows; ranked trade tables are USDA PSD market-year 2025/26 (trader reference). Years differ.

Customs data record 34.5 Mt of wheat exports from Russia in 2024 (CEPII BACI); USDA PSD gives 55.5 Mt for 2023/24 and 43 Mt for 2024/25. These flows may rest on importers' declarations alone, so that destinations which do not report are missing; this is not established here.
